note: Maintained reference dataset for destination discovery. Coordinates are approximate centroids. Entry fees and opening hours are typical published values and are surfaced to users as 'approx.' with CURATED provenance -- they are not live quotes. Cost indices are multipliers against the national baseline in services/cost_model.py.
license: Dataset compiled for this project. Place geometry inspired by OpenStreetMap (ODbL) -- verify before commercial redistribution.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.blurb: Three UNESCO monuments within 10 km, doable as a tight two-day trip.
destinations.local_transport: Battery rickshaws near the Taj; autos elsewhere. Taj is closed Fridays.

destinations.name: Alappuzha (Alleppey)
destinations.blurb: Backwater canals, houseboats and village life at water level.
destinations.local_transport: Public ferries are very cheap; autos for short hops. Houseboats are a separate booking.

destinations.name: Amritsar
destinations.blurb: The Golden Temple, a border ceremony and the best dhaba food in the north.

airport.name: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee Intl

destinations.local_transport: E-rickshaws around the walled city; shared cabs to Wagah.

destinations.name: Port Blair & Havelock
destinations.blurb: Coral reefs and white sand, reached only by air or a long ferry.
destinations.local_transport: Inter-island ferries must be booked ahead; scooters on Havelock. Flights are the only practical access.

destinations.name: Araku Valley
destinations.blurb: Coffee valley reached by one of India's most scenic train rides.
destinations.local_transport: Take the Kirandul passenger train in; jeeps and autos in the valley.

destinations.name: Ajanta & Ellora (Aurangabad)
destinations.blurb: Two of the world's great rock-cut cave complexes, 100 km apart.
destinations.local_transport: MSRTC runs direct buses to both cave sites. Ajanta closes Mondays, Ellora Tuesdays.

destinations.name: Bir Billing
destinations.blurb: India's paragliding capital, with Tibetan monasteries in the same village.
destinations.local_transport: Village is walkable; jeeps shuttle up to the Billing take-off.

destinations.name: Bodh Gaya
destinations.blurb: Where the Buddha attained enlightenment, now ringed by monasteries from a dozen countries.
destinations.local_transport: E-rickshaws cover everything; the temple complex is walkable.

destinations.name: Chikmagalur
destinations.blurb: Karnataka's quieter coffee hills, with the state's highest peak behind them.
destinations.local_transport: Jeep hire for Mullayanagiri road; own vehicle strongly preferred.

destinations.name: Chitrakote & Bastar
destinations.blurb: India's widest waterfall and tribal haat markets that see almost no tourists.
destinations.local_transport: Cab from Jagdalpur; public transport to the falls is sparse.

destinations.name: Coorg (Madikeri)
destinations.blurb: Coffee estates, misty ridges and waterfalls in Karnataka's hill country.
destinations.local_transport: Hire a cab for the day; sights are 20-40 km apart with poor bus links.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.blurb: Tea gardens, a UNESCO steam railway and Kanchenjunga on a clear morning.
destinations.local_transport: Shared jeeps are the local workhorse; the Mall and Chowrasta are pedestrian.

destinations.name: Gangtok & East Sikkim
destinations.blurb: Clean ridge-top capital with high-altitude lakes a day trip away.
destinations.local_transport: Shared jeeps and taxis. Tsomgo Lake and Nathu La need permits arranged a day ahead.

destinations.name: Gir National Park (Sasan Gir)
destinations.blurb: The only place on earth with wild Asiatic lions.
destinations.local_transport: Safari permits must be booked online well ahead; autos locally.

destinations.name: Gokarna
destinations.blurb: Temple town with a string of cliff-separated beaches you reach on foot.
destinations.local_transport: Autos between town and beaches; the beach trek is the main route.

destinations.name: Hampi
destinations.blurb: A boulder-strewn Vijayanagara capital spread over 40 sq km of ruins.
destinations.local_transport: Rented bicycle or scooter is the only sane way to cover the ruins; autos for half-day tours.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.blurb: Pink-washed bazaars, hill forts and the most accessible of Rajasthan's cities.
destinations.local_transport: Metro on one corridor, plus very cheap autos. A composite monument ticket saves money.

destinations.name: Jaisalmer
destinations.blurb: A living sandstone fort on the edge of the Thar, with dunes an hour away.
destinations.local_transport: Fort is walkable; desert camps include jeep transfers.

destinations.name: Jodhpur
destinations.blurb: Blue old city under one of the most imposing forts in the country.
destinations.local_transport: Autos are cheap; the blue city lanes are walking-only in places.

destinations.name: Kasol & Tosh
destinations.blurb: Riverside hostels and short valley treks in the Parvati.
destinations.local_transport: HRTC bus to Barshaini, then shared jeep. Last stretch to Tosh is on foot.

destinations.name: Kaziranga
destinations.blurb: Two-thirds of the world's one-horned rhinos in tall-grass floodplain.
destinations.local_transport: Jeep and elephant safaris booked at the range offices; park closed mid-May to Oct.

destinations.name: Khajuraho
destinations.blurb: Chandela temple sculpture at a level of craft that is hard to overstate.
destinations.local_transport: The western group is walkable; cycle rickshaws for the eastern temples.

destinations.name: Kochi
destinations.blurb: Fort Kochi's spice-trade layers, Chinese nets and a strong art and food scene.
destinations.local_transport: Kochi Metro plus very cheap public ferries between Fort Kochi and Ernakulam.

destinations.name: Kodaikanal
destinations.blurb: Shola forest, a star-shaped lake and cliffs that drop into cloud.
destinations.local_transport: Rented cycle round the lake; cab or local bus for the viewpoint loop.

destinations.name: Kolkata
destinations.blurb: Colonial architecture, trams, coffee houses and the best street food value in India.
destinations.local_transport: The metro plus trams and buses make this the cheapest big city in India to get around.

destinations.name: Rann of Kutch (Bhuj)
destinations.blurb: A white salt desert and India's densest concentration of craft villages.
destinations.local_transport: Hire a car for the craft-village circuit; a permit is required for Dhordo.

destinations.name: Leh & Ladakh
destinations.blurb: High-altitude desert, Pangong's blue and passes above 5,000 m.
destinations.local_transport: Shared taxis run on fixed union rates. Reserve the first 24-36 h for acclimatisation.

destinations.name: Lonavala & Khandala
destinations.blurb: The closest green escape to Mumbai and Pune, with forts on both ridges.
destinations.local_transport: Local trains from Pune/Mumbai are very cheap; autos for the point loop.

destinations.name: Madurai
destinations.blurb: A living temple city that has been continuously inhabited for two millennia.
destinations.local_transport: Autos and city buses; the temple district is walkable.

destinations.name: Mahabaleshwar & Panchgani
destinations.blurb: Strawberry country on a plateau with a dozen cliff-edge viewpoints.
destinations.local_transport: Point-to-point taxi packages are standard; MSRTC buses to Panchgani.

destinations.name: Mahabalipuram
destinations.blurb: Pallava rock-cut temples right where the shore begins.
destinations.local_transport: Everything is within 3 km; walk or hire a cycle.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.blurb: Beas-valley base camp for snow, high passes and Himachali village walks.
destinations.local_transport: HRTC buses to Vashisht and Solang; shared cabs for Atal Tunnel runs.

destinations.name: McLeod Ganj & Dharamshala
destinations.blurb: Tibetan monasteries under the Dhauladhar wall, with easy ridge treks.
destinations.local_transport: Shared taxis up to Dharamkot and Bhagsu; the core is walkable but steep.

destinations.name: Mount Abu
destinations.blurb: Rajasthan's only hill station, with the extraordinary Dilwara marble temples.
destinations.local_transport: Town is compact; shared jeeps to Guru Shikhar and the sunset point.

destinations.name: Munnar
destinations.blurb: Tea-terraced slopes, cool air and viewpoints stacked above 1,500 m.
destinations.local_transport: Day-rate jeep or cab; sights are strung along steep ghat roads.

destinations.name: Mussoorie
destinations.blurb: Queen-of-the-hills ridge walks an hour above Dehradun.
destinations.local_transport: Mall Road is pedestrian-only in the evening; taxis for Kempty and Lal Tibba.

destinations.name: Mysuru
destinations.blurb: Palace city with a hilltop temple, a serious food scene and easy logistics.
destinations.local_transport: City buses and autos are cheap and plentiful; most sights are within 12 km.

destinations.name: Nainital
destinations.blurb: A lake town in a bowl of Kumaon ridges, with Himalayan views from the top.
destinations.local_transport: Mall Road walk plus shared taxis to Snow View and Tiffin Top.

destinations.name: North Goa
destinations.blurb: Beach shacks, Portuguese churches and the busiest nightlife strip on the west coast.
destinations.local_transport: Rented scooter is cheapest; app cabs exist but surge. Public buses thin out after dark.

destinations.name: Ooty
destinations.blurb: Colonial hill station reached by a UNESCO-listed mountain railway.
destinations.local_transport: Local buses to Coonoor and Doddabetta; autos in town. Book the toy train ahead.

destinations.name: Pachmarhi
destinations.blurb: Madhya Pradesh's only hill station, inside a biosphere reserve.
destinations.local_transport: Only registered gypsies may enter the park zones; book through the forest office.

destinations.name: Pelling & West Sikkim
destinations.blurb: The closest road-accessible Kanchenjunga views, with ruined monasteries below.
destinations.local_transport: Shared jeeps from Jorethang/Geyzing; a reserved cab for the sightseeing loop.

destinations.name: Puducherry
destinations.blurb: French-quarter streets, a seafront promenade and cafes that justify the trip.
destinations.local_transport: Rented two-wheeler or cycle; the White Town core is walkable.

destinations.name: Puri & Konark
destinations.blurb: Jagannath temple town plus the Sun Temple, 35 km up the coast.
destinations.local_transport: Cycle rickshaws in town; buses along the marine drive to Konark.

destinations.name: Pushkar
destinations.blurb: A sacred lake ringed by 400 temples and a famously cheap traveller strip.
destinations.local_transport: Entirely walkable; autos to Ajmer station.

destinations.name: Ranthambore
destinations.blurb: India's most reliable tiger sighting, around a 10th-century fort.
destinations.local_transport: Safari canters and gypsies are pre-booked; autos between town and gate.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.blurb: Ganga rapids, suspension bridges and India's densest cluster of yoga schools.
destinations.local_transport: Shared autos along the Tapovan-Laxman Jhula strip; most of it is walkable.

destinations.name: Shillong & Cherrapunji
destinations.blurb: Living root bridges, canyon waterfalls and the wettest place on record.
destinations.local_transport: Reserved cab is effectively required; shared sumos run the Guwahati-Shillong trunk.

attractions.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek

destinations.name: Shimla
destinations.blurb: Colonial summer capital reached by the Kalka-Shimla toy train.
destinations.local_transport: The Ridge and Mall are pedestrian-only; lifts and local buses for the rest.

destinations.name: South Goa
destinations.blurb: Quieter palm-backed beaches, slow afternoons and Goan-Portuguese villages.
destinations.local_transport: Scooter rental is standard; distances between beaches are long so plan clusters.

destinations.name: Spiti Valley (Kaza)
destinations.blurb: A cold desert at 3,800 m with thousand-year-old monasteries and no crowds.
destinations.local_transport: One HRTC bus a day; most travellers share a jeep. Plan for altitude acclimatisation.

destinations.name: Sundarbans
destinations.blurb: The world's largest mangrove forest, navigated entirely by boat.
destinations.local_transport: Package boat tours from Godkhali are the practical option; permits are included.

destinations.name: Tarkarli & Malvan
destinations.blurb: Clear-water Konkan beaches with India's cheapest scuba intro dives.
destinations.local_transport: Autos and rented two-wheelers; homestays usually arrange pickups.

destinations.name: Tirupati
destinations.blurb: One of the most visited pilgrimage sites on earth, with hill temples above it.
destinations.local_transport: APSRTC ghat buses run constantly up to Tirumala; book darshan slots online first.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.blurb: Lake palaces, ghats and hill-ringed water in Rajasthan's gentlest city.
destinations.local_transport: Old city is walkable; autos elsewhere. Rooftop cafes cluster near Lal Ghat.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.blurb: Ghats, river ritual and lanes that have not been redrawn in centuries.
destinations.local_transport: Walk the ghats; boats are the real transport. Autos cannot enter the old lanes.

destinations.name: Varkala
destinations.blurb: A red cliff above the Arabian Sea, lined with cafes and yoga shalas.
destinations.local_transport: Cliff strip is walkable; autos to the station and temple.

destinations.name: Wayanad
destinations.blurb: Spice plantations, caves and a wildlife sanctuary in Kerala's green north.
destinations.local_transport: Cab for the day; sights sprawl 30-50 km across the district.
